# GateLink — Smart Society OS & Gated Community ERP

> GateLink (https://gatelink.in) is India's next-generation society management software, security guard app, and automated RWA accounting platform designed for modern housing societies and gated communities.

## Overview
GateLink simplifies residential complex operations through four integrated software modules:
1. **Society Management ERP**: Real-time resident directory, facility bookings, AGM voting, complaint desk, digital notice broadcast, and staff management.
2. **Visitor & Gate Management**: 4-digit numeric & QR gate passes, delivery pre-approvals, vehicle number lookup, and visitor pass logs.
3. **Maintenance & Financial Management**: Automated monthly invoicing, GST calculation, SAC 999598 compliance, Cashfree online payment gateway, and instant ledger reconciliation.
4. **Security Guard Mobile App**: Fast entry logging, offline-first fallback, domestic helper attendance, and GPS-stamped QR night patrol checkpoints.

## Key Product Pages
- [Society Management Software](https://gatelink.in/society-management-software): Complete RWA enterprise resource planning software for housing societies and apartment associations in India.
- [Visitor Management System](https://gatelink.in/visitor-management): Fast QR pass check-in, delivery driver pre-approval, and vehicle access controls.
- [Maintenance Management Software](https://gatelink.in/maintenance-management): Automated monthly maintenance invoicing, online payments via Cashfree, automated payment receipts, and society accounts ledger.
- [Security Management & Guard App](https://gatelink.in/security-management): Security guard mobile app, visitor authentication, emergency SOS alarms, and QR patrol monitoring.
- [Security & DPDP Compliance Center](https://gatelink.in/security): Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 compliance, TLS 1.3 encryption, AES-256 vault storage, and multi-tenant isolation.
- [Pricing & Demo](https://gatelink.in/contact): Transparent flat pricing (₹15–₹25/flat/month), 0 setup fees, 14-day free pilot for RWAs.
- [Partner & Vendor Program](https://gatelink.in/partners): Security agencies, facility management firms, and system integrators partnership portal.
- [Download Apps](https://gatelink.in/download): Native Android & iOS apps for residents, owners, and security guards.
- [Knowledge Base & Blog](https://gatelink.in/blog): Guides on society accounting, RWA bylaws compliance, gate security best practices, and facility automation.

## Legal & Compliance
- [Privacy Policy](https://gatelink.in/privacy): DPDP Act 2023 compliant data collection, processing, and erasure policies.
- [Terms of Service](https://gatelink.in/terms): Service level agreement, subscription terms, and user guidelines.
- [Data Processing Agreement](https://gatelink.in/data-processing): Enterprise DPA for housing societies and facility management agencies.
- [Grievance Redressal](https://gatelink.in/grievance): Data Protection Officer (DPO) contact and statutory grievance escalation mechanism.
- [Account Deletion](https://gatelink.in/delete-account): Self-service account deletion and data anonymization portal.
- [Refund Policy](https://gatelink.in/refund-policy): SaaS subscription cancellation and payment refund terms.

## Technical Specifications
- **Architecture**: Multi-tenant cloud backend with isolated society scopes.
- **Mobile Clients**: Flutter native applications for Android & iOS (Resident App & Guard App).
- **Web Portals**: React & Vite portals for Residents, Society Management Committee Admins, and Super Admins.
- **Payments**: Integrated Cashfree Payments gateway supporting UPI, Net Banking, Credit/Debit Cards with automated webhook reconciliation.
- **Communications**: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notifications, automated WhatsApp visitor approvals, and SMS alerts.
